sign_in.reset_notice: Your password has been updated. Sign in with your new password.
sign_in.first_time_body: Use the temporary password your administrator gave you — you'll choose your own password next. No temporary password? <firstLoginLink>Set your password by email</firstLoginLink>.

new_document.step1_hint: The type determines the section template + framework checks applied.
new_document.step2_title: Pick the sources this document is written from
new_document.step2_hint: Mandatory — the writer (and later, the AI drafter) uses these as evidence.
new_document.step2_showing_uploaded_prefix: Showing the sources you selected — tick
new_document.upload_existing_title: Pick from the source documents already in this project's library
new_document.no_sources_library: This project's library has no source documents yet.
new_document.no_sources_match_category: No sources match the recommended categories for this document type.
new_document.select_one_source_hint: Select at least one source to continue.
new_document.ta_hint: Set by the project. Only an Admin can change it after the document is created.
new_document.assignee_hint: The assignee is auto-added as the Responsible (R) on the RACI matrix.
new_document.step4_hint: The AI drafter reads your {{count}} source(s) and fills in each section as a first-pass draft. You can then edit, accept, or regenerate per section in the editor.
new_document.ai_on_description: The worker queues a background job the moment you click Create. The document opens immediately in "Authoring"; sections fill in over 2–6 minutes. You can close this tab — a notification lands when drafting completes.
new_document.ai_on_note: Current build uses deterministic placeholder content per section — real LLM swap is pending ANTHROPIC_API_KEY provisioning (same pattern as voice-note transcription).
new_document.ai_off_description: I'll draft every section myself. The document opens with the section skeleton only — no AI involvement.
new_document.ai_disabled_no_sources: AI drafting is disabled because you haven't attached any source documents. Go back to step 2 to add one, or continue with "Create blank".
new_document.ai_instructions_help: Tell the AI how you want the draft written — language, tone, structure. These instructions apply to every section the AI drafts (initial draft and any later regenerate). Not shown to reviewers.
new_document.ai_instructions_placeholder: e.g. Draft in Japanese. Use short paragraphs. Include a dosing table where helpful.
new_document.best_practices_empty: No best-practice items apply to {{docType}}. Platform admins can publish items via <libraryPath>Library → Best Practices</libraryPath>.
